reviews.text: It was stating $4.99 a year but when you click on it then it changes to $4.99 a week

reviews.title: Lame
reviews.text: This app costs a fair bit and is worse than free apps that do similar things.  I regret wasting my money and  assume I misheard the person who recommended it.  Even with paying, the radar function does not forecast (eg it stops about 5 ago) and the forecast screen show the same data any free app shows.  I really wish I paid weekly so I could have tried it first.  You can change temperature from C to F but the number doesn’t even change.  That is just one example of what a scam this app is.

reviews.text: This used to be my favourite app to check the rain radar map before a dog walk. This function is no longer working on the free app so I will be deleting this app as it’s offering nothing

reviews.title: Recent Issues
reviews.text: Used the free version of this app for years and generally been very good. However issues with no data January 26. Upgraded to annual subscription and the radar rain layer hasn’t functioned since, often won my pick up my location and often no forecast - just says no data 🤷🏼‍♀️ I’ve reinstalled several times with no improvement.

reviews.title: Not showing any thing
reviews.text: I need help. I paid for the app and it’s not showing me what I see when I purchased the app. The pics show much more detailed information than what is on my phone. Please help me.

reviews.title: App does not work at this time.  Do not purchase this app.
reviews.text: Do not buy this app, it is not working at all.  It is currently not populating any current weather data or forecast data.  Sent an email 30+ days ago and received no response from Impala Studios the developer.  I have to assume at this time the developer is no longer supporting this weather app.  It’s too bad it was once my favorite app.  I have moved to My Radar which works great and is feature rich. They are actively supporting and improving their app.  Well worth the yearly cost!!!

reviews.title: App does not work
reviews.text: Prepaid for 1yr. to even gain access- only to find app does not work! Canceled subscription 5 minutes later- but still charged for the full year 😠

reviews.title: App does not work
reviews.text: Cannot set a location to get any sort of forecast. Neither “use my location” nor typing in the location works, only a blank screen results. Also, upon first opening the app, there was no way to get past the subscription screen to access a free or trial version, though force-quitting and restarting the app did provide access.

reviews.title: Will not load the forecast
reviews.text: Used to be my favorite weather app, but now it won’t load the forecast.  It has become pretty useless and I have the paid subscription through the spring.  I've tried reboots of my phone but nothing seems to fix what is going on with the app.

reviews.title: Inaccurate
